thread:
Sarah Park: FYI — Azure Marketplace partner reported inference regressions when we combine CUDA 12.2 + driver 535 + our quantized kernel. They saw ~2x latency at tail p95. Can we triage?
Mike Chen: thanks, tagging eng-runtime. Can you paste the exact stack and a minimal repro?
Deepa Rao: from partner: 'model runs fine on driver 525 / CUDA 11.8. Upgrading to 535 + 12.2 shows stalls during KV cache refill.' They attached logs but short version: OOM-ish stalls, long GPU kernels.
Mike Chen: aha. I suspect a kernel selection mismatch in the fused-attn path after CUDA upgrade. Repro steps requested. @Sarah can you get the partner to run this quick container test?
Sarah Park: sent repro snippet to partner; they ran it. Their command: ```docker run --gpus all --rm nvcr.io/partner/sample-run:latest ./serve --model gpt-small --batch 1 --seq_len 1024``` They also shared the driver version: 535.86 and CUDA runtime 12.2.
Andre Lopez: tagging our infra tests — we'll run that same container on our staging clusters with both driver 525+11.8 and 535+12.2. Expect results within a couple hours.
Mike Chen: in the meantime, quick mitigation: add a marketplace image tag that pins driver shim to 525 / cu11 compatible runtime. That avoids breaking customer deployments.
Deepa Rao: partner asked if we can ship a hotfix on their marketplace listing instead of them rolling back. They want a signed binary we can push to marketplace. Legal/partner handshake needed.
Tom Fisher: legal okay with sending a signed driver shim artifact under existing MSA, but we need export/compliance review. I'll fast-track if eng provides a short risk summary.
Jen Ortiz: release windows — if we do a hotfix image, we should target a canary deploy over the next 24h and full rollout in 72h. Need release owner + rollback plan.
Mike Chen: I'll own the release. Rollback plan: marketplace tag points back to previous image, and runtime will fallback to legacy fused kernels when CUDA_VERSION >=12.2 detected. Patch ready to try:
```
# runtime config override
kernel_policy:
  fused_attn: prefer_legacy_if_cuda_ge: "12.2"
```
Sarah Park: partner requested telemetry: they want p50/p95 before/after. Can we include a small perf test harness in the hotfix image?
Andre Lopez: yes — we'll add a tiny bench script that runs 10 short seqs and emits token latency hist. I can push it to canary.
deploy-bot: Canary build 2026-03-21-0823 created for image redwood/inference:canary-driver-compat-2026-03-21
Mike Chen: running the canary on staging with driver 535 now. If we see >20% regression still, we escalate to vendor kernels.
Deepa Rao: I'll loop in driver vendor contacts. If it's a regression in 535's scheduler, they may have a micropatch. I can open a ticket but timeline unclear.
Tom Fisher: keep me posted before we ship anything to the marketplace; I'll prepare the POA for compliance.
Jen Ortiz: also flagging product: marketplace listing copy needs short note about pinned driver compatibility to avoid surprise for customers.
Sarah Park: agreed. I'll prepare a partner-facing note: "Temporary compatibility image pinned to NVIDIA driver 525/CUDA 11.8 due to performance regression on 535+12.2; hotfix canary in progress."
Andre Lopez: staging canary results: pre-patch (525/11.8) p95=210ms, post-patch (535/12.2) p95=480ms. With kernel_policy override p95=220ms. So override seems to recover perf.
Mike Chen: great. That means shipping the override in canary image is acceptable. Next steps: 1) finalize patch, 2) legal/compliance signoff, 3) canary to partner, 4) full marketplace push and docs update.
Deepa Rao: partner asks whether we can add a note in the marketplace image metadata: "For best performance on GPU instances using NVIDIA driver >=535 please use runtime tag 'compat-525'."
Sarah Park: will add that. Also planning a short joint announcement email to customers scheduled after full rollout — simple compliance/compat note, not a marketing campaign.
Jen Ortiz: timeline: canary to partner tonight UTC, full rollout in 48-72h assuming no new issues. Please upload the canary artifacts to the internal release bucket and ping me.
Mike Chen: uploaded (s3://redwood-release/canaries/driver-compat/20260321). Pinged Deepa and Tom with links.
Tom Fisher: received. Starting compliance checklist now.
Andre Lopez: postmortem action items logged: - add automated matrix test for CUDA 12.x + drivers 530-540 - add runtime flag auto-fallback when perf regressions detected - add marketplace metadata field for pinned-driver recommendation.
Sarah Park: thanks all. I'll coordinate partner comms once legal signs off. :thumbsup:
Deepa Rao: loopback: vendor opened internal ticket NV#8921, will escalate if more customers affected. I'll update thread. :ear
Mike Chen: keeping this thread as canonical. Will update with canary metrics and rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to partner-qa cluster completed at 1905555700
Mike Chen: partner confirmed canary perf matches staging (~p95 230ms). Partner signed off for rollout.
Sarah Park: moving to marketplace push tomorrow morning, will post final note here when live.
